test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A and B together can complete a task in 20 days while B alone can complete the same task in 60 days. A alone will be able to complete the same task in:
solution:
**Given:**

A and B together: 20 days

B alone: 60 days

**Formula Used:**

1/A + 1/B = 1/Together Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 20 and 60 for total work which is 60 units.

A and B together complete 60 units in 20 days

⇒ Rate = 60 / 20 = 3 units/day

B alone completes 60 units in 60 days

⇒ Rate = 60 / 60 = 1 unit/day

Rate of A alone = Rate of A and B - Rate of B

⇒ 3 - 1 = 2 units/day

Time taken by A alone = Total work / Rate of A

⇒ 60 units / 2 units/day = 30 days

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
